preconditions.description: The length of the permutations is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
Both permutations p and s have length n.

preconditions.expression: set(p) == set(range(1, n + 1)) and set(s) == set(range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Both permutations p and s contain all numbers from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the minimum number of coins required to transform permutation p into permutation s.
The second line of the output is the number of operations k needed to get the solution.
The number of operations k matches the number of operations listed in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation consists of two distinct indices i and j between 1 and n inclusive.
Applying the sequence of operations to permutation p results in permutation s.

postconditions.expression: min_coins == sum(abs(i - j) for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: The total number of coins spent is the sum of the absolute differences of the indices for each operation.
